# Material[¶](#material "Permalink to this heading")

The Material commands are used to define the materials in a model.

## Create materials[¶](#create-materials "Permalink to this heading")

        ```python
        session.odbs[name].Material
        ```

        Note

        Check [Material on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-materialpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.MaterialOdb.MaterialOdb.Material-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   name[¶](#abaqus.Material.MaterialOdb.MaterialOdb.Material.name "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying the name of the new material.

            description=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Material.MaterialOdb.MaterialOdb.Material.description "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying user description of the material. The default value is an empty
                string.

            materialIdentifier=`''`[¶](#abaqus.Material.MaterialOdb.MaterialOdb.Material.materialIdentifier "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A String specifying material identifier for customer use. The default value is an empty
                string.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Material.MaterialOdb.MaterialOdb.Material-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   A Material object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Material.MaterialOdb.MaterialOdb.Material-return-type "Permalink to this headline")

## Assign properties to the material[¶](#assign-properties-to-the-material "Permalink to this heading")

*class* Material(*[name](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material "abaqus.Material.Material.Material.__init__.name (Python parameter)")*, *[description](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material "abaqus.Material.Material.Material.__init__.description (Python parameter)")=`''`*, *[materialIdentifier](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material "abaqus.Material.Material.Material.__init__.materialIdentifier (Python parameter)")=`''`*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Material/Material.py#L121-L4066)[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`MaterialBase`](#abaqus.Material.MaterialBase.MaterialBase "abaqus.Material.MaterialBase.MaterialBase (Python class) — Bases: object")

    A Material object is the object used to specify a material. The Material object stores the various
    settings that determine how a material behaves. A material is created by combining one or more individual
    material options and sub options. A particular material option is associated with the Material object
    through a member. For example: the **acousticMedium** member may contain an AcousticMedium object. The
    alternative of having a MaterialOption abstract base class and a container of MaterialOptions was rejected
    because it would make it more difficult to enforce the fact that one Material object cannot contain two
    AcousticMedium objects, for example.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import material
    mdb.models[name].materials[name]
    import odbMaterial
    session.odbs[name].materials[name]
    ```

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * MATERIAL

    Note

    Check [Material on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-materialpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    :   This method creates an AcousticMedium object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].materials[name].AcousticMedium
        session.odbs[name].materials[name].AcousticMedium
        ```

        Note

        Check [AcousticMedium on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-acousticmediumpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.AcousticMedium-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   acousticVolumetricDrag=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.AcousticMedium.acousticVolumetricDrag "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the volumetricTable data is specified. The default value is
                OFF.

            temperatureDependencyB=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.AcousticMedium.temperatureDependencyB "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data in **bulkTable** depend on temperature. The default
                value is OFF.

            temperatureDependencyV=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.AcousticMedium.temperatureDependencyV "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data in **volumetricTable** depend on temperature. The
                default value is OFF.

            dependenciesB=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.AcousticMedium.dependenciesB "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies for the data in **bulkTable**.
                The default value is 0.

            dependenciesV=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.AcousticMedium.dependenciesV "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies for the data in
                **volumetricTable**. The default value is 0.

            bulkTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.AcousticMedium.bulkTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the following:

                * Bulk modulus.
                * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
                * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
                * Value of the second field variable.
                * Etc.

            volumetricTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.AcousticMedium.volumetricTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the following:

                * Volumetric drag.
                * Frequency.
                * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
                * Value of the first field variable, if the data depend on field variables.
                * Value of the second field variable.
                * Etc.

                The default value is an empty sequence.

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.DuctileDamageInitiation-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   table[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.DuctileDamageInitiation.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described in the “Table data”
                section.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.MSFLD`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.DuctileDamageInitiation.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation definition. Possible values are FLD
                and MSFLD. The default value is MSFLD.

            feq=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.DuctileDamageInitiation.feq "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for equivalent
                Plastic strains. The default value is 10.0.

            fnn=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.DuctileDamageInitiation.fnn "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for strains
                normal to the groove direction. The default value is 10.0.

            fnt=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.DuctileDamageInitiation.fnt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for shear
                strains. The default value is 10.0.

            :   An Int specifying the frequency, in increments, at which the Marciniak-Kuczynski
                analysis is going to be performed. The default value is 1.

            ks=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.DuctileDamageInitiation.ks "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of Ks. The default value is 0.0.

            :   An Int specifying the number of imperfections to be considered for the evaluation of the
                Marciniak-Kuczynski analysis. These imperfections are assumed to be equally spaced in
                the angular direction. The default value is 4.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.DuctileDamageInitiation.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data depend on temperature. The default value is OFF.

            dependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.DuctileDamageInitiation.dependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies. The default value is 0.

            alpha=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.DuctileDamageInitiation.alpha "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the coefficient that will multiply the shear

            omega=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.DuctileDamageInitiation.omega "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor used for filtering the ratio of principal strain rates

            :   A Float specifying the tolerance within which the damage initiation criterion must be

            direction=`abaqusConstants.NMORI`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.DuctileDamageInitiation.direction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation direction. Possible values are NMORI
                and TMORI. The default value is NMORI.

            type=`abaqusConstants.ISOTROPIC`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Elastic.type "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of elasticity data provided. Possible values are:

                * ISOTROPIC
                * ORTHOTROPIC

        ```

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Eos-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   type=`abaqusConstants.IDEALGAS`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Eos.type "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the equation of state. Possible values are USUP, JWL,
                IDEALGAS, TABULAR, and IGNITIONANDGROWTH. The default value is IDEALGAS.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Eos.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data in **gasSpecificTable** depend on temperature. The
                default value is OFF.

            dependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Eos.dependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies for the data in
                **gasSpecificTable**. The default value is 0.

            detonationEnergy=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Eos.detonationEnergy "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the detonation energy text field. The default value is 0.0.

            solidTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Eos.solidTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the following:

                * \(A\_{s}\).
                * \(B\_{s}\).
                * \({\omega}\_{s}\).
                * \(R\_{1s}\).
                * \(R\_{2s}\).

                The default value is an empty sequence.

            gasTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Eos.gasTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the following:

                * \(A\_{g}\).
                * \(B\_{g}\).
                * \({\omega}\_{g}\).
                * \(R\_{1g}\).
                * \(R\_{2g}\).

                The default value is an empty sequence.

            reactionTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Eos.reactionTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the following:

                * Initial Pressure, \(I\).
                * Product co-volume, \(a\).
                * Exponent on the unreacted fraction (ignition term), \(x\).
                * First burn rate coefficient, \(G\_{1}\)
                * Exponent on the unreacted fraction (growth term), \(c\).
                * Exponent on the reacted fraction (growth term), \(d\).
                * Pressure exponent (growth term), \(y\).
                * Second burn rate coefficient, \(G\_{2}\).
                * Exponent on the unreacted fraction (completion term), \(e\).
                * Exponent on the reacted fraction (completion term), \(g\).
                * Pressure exponent (completion term), \(z\).
                * Initial reacted fraction, \({F^{max}}\_{ig}\).
                * Maximum reacted fraction for the growth term, \({F^{max}}\_{G1}\).
                * Minimum reacted fraction, \({F^{min}}\_{G2}\).

                The default value is an empty sequence.

            gasSpecificTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Eos.gasSpecificTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the following:

                * Specific Heat per unit mass.
                * Temperature dependent data.
                * Value of first field variable.
                * Value of second field variable.
                * Etc.

                The default value is an empty sequence.

            table=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Eos.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described below. The default
                value is an empty sequence.

        mdb.models[name].materials[name].FldDamageInitiation
        session.odbs[name].materials[name].FldDamageInitiation
        ```

        Note

        Check [FldDamageInitiation on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-flddamageinitiationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   table[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described in the “Table data”
                section.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.MSFLD`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation definition. Possible values are FLD
                and MSFLD. The default value is MSFLD.

            feq=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.feq "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for equivalent
                Plastic strains. The default value is 10.0.

            fnn=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.fnn "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for strains
                normal to the groove direction. The default value is 10.0.

            fnt=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.fnt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for shear
                strains. The default value is 10.0.

            frequency=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.frequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the frequency, in increments, at which the Marciniak-Kuczynski
                analysis is going to be performed. The default value is 1.

            ks=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.ks "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of Ks. The default value is 0.0.

            numberImperfections=`4`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.numberImperfections "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of imperfections to be considered for the evaluation of the
                Marciniak-Kuczynski analysis. These imperfections are assumed to be equally spaced in
                the angular direction. The default value is 4.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data depend on temperature. The default value is OFF.

            dependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.dependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies. The default value is 0.

            alpha=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.alpha "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the coefficient that will multiply the shear
                contribution to the Hashin’s fiber initiation criterion. The default value is 0.0.

            omega=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.omega "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor used for filtering the ratio of principal strain rates
                used for the evaluation of the MSFLD damage initiation criterion. The default value is
                1.0.

            tolerance=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.tolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the tolerance within which the damage initiation criterion must be
                satisfied. The default value is 0.05.

            direction=`abaqusConstants.NMORI`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.FldDamageInitiation.direction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation direction. Possible values are NMORI
                and TMORI. The default value is NMORI.

    :   This method creates A DamageInitiation object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].materials[name].HashinDamageInitiation
        session.odbs[name].materials[name].HashinDamageInitiation
        ```

        Note

        Check [HashinDamageInitiation on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-hashindamageinitiationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   table[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described in the “Table data”
                section.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.MSFLD`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation definition. Possible values are FLD
                and MSFLD. The default value is MSFLD.

            feq=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.feq "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for equivalent
                Plastic strains. The default value is 10.0.

            fnn=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.fnn "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for strains
                normal to the groove direction. The default value is 10.0.

            fnt=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.fnt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for shear
                strains. The default value is 10.0.

            frequency=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.frequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the frequency, in increments, at which the Marciniak-Kuczynski
                analysis is going to be performed. The default value is 1.

            ks=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.ks "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of Ks. The default value is 0.0.

            numberImperfections=`4`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.numberImperfections "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of imperfections to be considered for the evaluation of the
                Marciniak-Kuczynski analysis. These imperfections are assumed to be equally spaced in
                the angular direction. The default value is 4.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data depend on temperature. The default value is OFF.

            dependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.dependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies. The default value is 0.

            alpha=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.alpha "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the coefficient that will multiply the shear
                contribution to the Hashin’s fiber initiation criterion. The default value is 0.0.

            omega=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.omega "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor used for filtering the ratio of principal strain rates
                used for the evaluation of the MSFLD damage initiation criterion. The default value is
                1.0.

            tolerance=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.tolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the tolerance within which the damage initiation criterion must be
                satisfied. The default value is 0.05.

            direction=`abaqusConstants.NMORI`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.HashinDamageInitiation.direction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation direction. Possible values are NMORI
                and TMORI. The default value is NMORI.

        :   A DamageInitiation object.

        :   `DamageInitiation`

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   table[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described below. This argument is
                valid only if **testData** = OFF.

            type=`abaqusConstants.UNKNOWN`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.type "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of strain energy potential. Possible values
                are:ARRUDA\_BOYCEMARLOWMOONEY\_RIVLINNEO\_HOOKEOGDENPOLYNOMIALREDUCED\_POLYNOMIALUSERVAN\_DER\_WAALSYEOHUNKNOWNThe
                default value is UNKNOWN.

            moduliTimeScale=`abaqusConstants.LONG_TERM`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.moduliTimeScale "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the nature of the time response. Possible values are
                INSTANTANEOUS and LONG\_TERM. The default value is LONG\_TERM.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data depend on temperature. The default value is OFF.

            n=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.n "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the order of the strain energy potential. The default value is 1.If
                **testData** = ON and **type** = POLYNOMIAL, **n** can take only the values 1 or 2.If
                **testData** = ON and **type** = OGDEN or if **testData** = OFF for either type, 1 ≤n≤n≤ 6.If
                **type** = USER, this argument cannot be used.

            beta=`abaqusConstants.FITTED_VALUE`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.beta "Permalink to this definition")
            :   The SymbolicConstant FITTED\_VALUE or a Float specifying the invariant mixture parameter.
                This argument is valid only if **testData** = ON and **type** = VAN\_DER\_WAALS. The default value
                is FITTED\_VALUE.

            testData=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.testData "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether test data are supplied. The default value is ON.

            compressible=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.compressible "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the hyperelastic material is compressible. This parameter
                is applicable only to user-defined hyperelastic materials. The default value is OFF.

            properties=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.properties "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of property values needed as data for the user-defined
                hyperelastic material. The default value is 0.

            deviatoricResponse=`abaqusConstants.UNIAXIAL`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.deviatoricResponse "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying which test data to use. Possible values are UNIAXIAL,
                BIAXIAL, and PLANAR. The default value is UNIAXIAL.

            volumetricResponse=`abaqusConstants.DEFAULT`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.volumetricResponse "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the volumetric response. Possible values are DEFAULT,
                VOLUMETRIC\_DATA, POISSON\_RATIO, and LATERAL\_NOMINAL\_STRAIN. The default value is
                DEFAULT.

            poissonRatio=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.poissonRatio "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the poisson ratio. This argument is valid only if
                **volumetricResponse** = POISSON\_RATIO. The default value is 0.0.

            materialType=`abaqusConstants.ISOTROPIC`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.materialType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of material. Possible values are ISOTROPIC and
                ANISOTROPIC. The default value is ISOTROPIC.

            anisotropicType=`abaqusConstants.FUNG_ANISOTROPIC`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.anisotropicType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of strain energy potential. Possible values are
                FUNG\_ANISOTROPIC, FUNG\_ORTHOTROPIC, HOLZAPFEL, and USER\_DEFINED. The default value is
                FUNG\_ANISOTROPIC.

            formulation=`abaqusConstants.STRAIN`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.formulation "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of formulation. Possible values are STRAIN and
                INVARIANT. The default value is STRAIN.

            behaviorType=`abaqusConstants.INCOMPRESSIBLE`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.behaviorType "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type of anisotropic hyperelastic material behavior.
                Possible values are INCOMPRESSIBLE and COMPRESSIBLE. The default value is
                INCOMPRESSIBLE.

            dependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.dependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies for the data
                in\*volumetricTable\* . The default value is 0.

            localDirections=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperelastic.localDirections "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of local directions for the data in\*volumetricTable\* . The
                default value is 0.

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperfoam-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   testData=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperfoam.testData "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether test data are supplied. The default value is OFF.

            poisson=`None`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Hyperfoam.poisson "Permalink to this definition")

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   table[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described in the “Table data”
                section.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.MSFLD`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation definition. Possible values are FLD
                and MSFLD. The default value is MSFLD.

            feq=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.feq "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for equivalent
                Plastic strains. The default value is 10.0.

            fnn=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.fnn "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for strains
                normal to the groove direction. The default value is 10.0.

            fnt=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.fnt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for shear
                strains. The default value is 10.0.

            frequency=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.frequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the frequency, in increments, at which the Marciniak-Kuczynski
                analysis is going to be performed. The default value is 1.

            ks=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.ks "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of Ks. The default value is 0.0.

            numberImperfections=`4`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.numberImperfections "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of imperfections to be considered for the evaluation of the
                Marciniak-Kuczynski analysis. These imperfections are assumed to be equally spaced in
                the angular direction. The default value is 4.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data depend on temperature. The default value is OFF.

            dependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.dependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies. The default value is 0.

            alpha=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.alpha "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the coefficient that will multiply the shear
                contribution to the Hashin’s fiber initiation criterion. The default value is 0.0.

            omega=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.omega "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor used for filtering the ratio of principal strain rates
                used for the evaluation of the MSFLD damage initiation criterion. The default value is
                1.0.

            tolerance=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.tolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the tolerance within which the damage initiation criterion must be
                satisfied. The default value is 0.05.

            direction=`abaqusConstants.NMORI`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.JohnsonCookDamageInitiation.direction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation direction. Possible values are NMORI
                and TMORI. The default value is NMORI.

    :   This method creates A DamageInitiation object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].materials[name].MaxeDamageInitiation
        session.odbs[name].materials[name].MaxeDamageInitiation
        ```

        Note

        Check [MaxeDamageInitiation on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-maxedamageinitiationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   table[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described in the “Table data”
                section.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.MSFLD`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation definition. Possible values are FLD
                and MSFLD. The default value is MSFLD.

            feq=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.feq "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for equivalent
                Plastic strains. The default value is 10.0.

            fnn=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.fnn "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for strains
                normal to the groove direction. The default value is 10.0.

            fnt=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.fnt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for shear
                strains. The default value is 10.0.

            frequency=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.frequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the frequency, in increments, at which the Marciniak-Kuczynski
                analysis is going to be performed. The default value is 1.

            ks=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.ks "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of Ks. The default value is 0.0.

            numberImperfections=`4`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.numberImperfections "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of imperfections to be considered for the evaluation of the
                Marciniak-Kuczynski analysis. These imperfections are assumed to be equally spaced in
                the angular direction. The default value is 4.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data depend on temperature. The default value is OFF.

            dependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.dependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies. The default value is 0.

            alpha=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.alpha "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the coefficient that will multiply the shear
                contribution to the Hashin’s fiber initiation criterion. The default value is 0.0.

            omega=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.omega "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor used for filtering the ratio of principal strain rates
                used for the evaluation of the MSFLD damage initiation criterion. The default value is
                1.0.

            tolerance=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.tolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the tolerance within which the damage initiation criterion must be
                satisfied. The default value is 0.05.

            direction=`abaqusConstants.NMORI`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.direction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation direction. Possible values are NMORI
                and TMORI. The default value is NMORI.

            position=`abaqusConstants.CENTROID`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation.position "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation position. Possible values are
                CENTROID, CRACKTIP and COMBINED. The default value is CENTROID.

        Returns:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation-returns "Permalink to this headline")
        :   A DamageInitiation object.

        Return type:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxeDamageInitiation-return-type "Permalink to this headline")
        :   `DamageInitiation`

    :   This method creates A DamageInitiation object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].materials[name].MaxsDamageInitiation
        session.odbs[name].materials[name].MaxsDamageInitiation
        ```

        Note

        Check [MaxsDamageInitiation on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-maxsdamageinitiationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   table[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described in the “Table data”
                section.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.MSFLD`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation definition. Possible values are FLD
                and MSFLD. The default value is MSFLD.

            feq=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.feq "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for equivalent
                Plastic strains. The default value is 10.0.

            fnn=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.fnn "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for strains
                normal to the groove direction. The default value is 10.0.

            fnt=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.fnt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for shear
                strains. The default value is 10.0.

            frequency=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.frequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the frequency, in increments, at which the Marciniak-Kuczynski
                analysis is going to be performed. The default value is 1.

            ks=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.ks "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of Ks. The default value is 0.0.

            numberImperfections=`4`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.numberImperfections "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of imperfections to be considered for the evaluation of the
                Marciniak-Kuczynski analysis. These imperfections are assumed to be equally spaced in
                the angular direction. The default value is 4.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data depend on temperature. The default value is OFF.

            dependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.dependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies. The default value is 0.

            alpha=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.alpha "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the coefficient that will multiply the shear
                contribution to the Hashin’s fiber initiation criterion. The default value is 0.0.

            omega=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.omega "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor used for filtering the ratio of principal strain rates
                used for the evaluation of the MSFLD damage initiation criterion. The default value is
                1.0.

            tolerance=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.tolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the tolerance within which the damage initiation criterion must be
                satisfied. The default value is 0.05.

            direction=`abaqusConstants.NMORI`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.direction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation direction. Possible values are NMORI
                and TMORI. The default value is NMORI.

            position=`abaqusConstants.CENTROID`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MaxsDamageInitiation.position "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation position. Possible values are
                CENTROID, CRACKTIP and COMBINED. The default value is CENTROID.

    :   This method creates A DamageInitiation object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].materials[name].MsfldDamageInitiation
        session.odbs[name].materials[name].MsfldDamageInitiation
        ```

        Note

        Check [MsfldDamageInitiation on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-msflddamageinitiationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   table[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described in the “Table data”
                section.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.MSFLD`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation definition. Possible values are FLD
                and MSFLD. The default value is MSFLD.

            feq=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.feq "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for equivalent
                Plastic strains. The default value is 10.0.

            fnn=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.fnn "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for strains
                normal to the groove direction. The default value is 10.0.

            fnt=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.fnt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for shear
                strains. The default value is 10.0.

            frequency=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.frequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the frequency, in increments, at which the Marciniak-Kuczynski
                analysis is going to be performed. The default value is 1.

            ks=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.ks "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of Ks. The default value is 0.0.

            numberImperfections=`4`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.numberImperfections "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of imperfections to be considered for the evaluation of the
                Marciniak-Kuczynski analysis. These imperfections are assumed to be equally spaced in
                the angular direction. The default value is 4.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data depend on temperature. The default value is OFF.

            dependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.dependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies. The default value is 0.

            alpha=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.alpha "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the coefficient that will multiply the shear
                contribution to the Hashin’s fiber initiation criterion. The default value is 0.0.

            omega=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.omega "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor used for filtering the ratio of principal strain rates
                used for the evaluation of the MSFLD damage initiation criterion. The default value is
                1.0.

            tolerance=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.tolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the tolerance within which the damage initiation criterion must be
                satisfied. The default value is 0.05.

            direction=`abaqusConstants.NMORI`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.MsfldDamageInitiation.direction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation direction. Possible values are NMORI
                and TMORI. The default value is NMORI.

    :   This method creates A DamageInitiation object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].materials[name].QuadeDamageInitiation
        session.odbs[name].materials[name].QuadeDamageInitiation
        ```

        Note

        Check [QuadeDamageInitiation on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-quadedamageinitiationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   table[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described in the “Table data”
                section.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.MSFLD`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation definition. Possible values are FLD
                and MSFLD. The default value is MSFLD.

            feq=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.feq "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for equivalent
                Plastic strains. The default value is 10.0.

            fnn=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.fnn "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for strains
                normal to the groove direction. The default value is 10.0.

            fnt=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.fnt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for shear
                strains. The default value is 10.0.

            frequency=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.frequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the frequency, in increments, at which the Marciniak-Kuczynski
                analysis is going to be performed. The default value is 1.

            ks=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.ks "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of Ks. The default value is 0.0.

            numberImperfections=`4`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.numberImperfections "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of imperfections to be considered for the evaluation of the
                Marciniak-Kuczynski analysis. These imperfections are assumed to be equally spaced in
                the angular direction. The default value is 4.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data depend on temperature. The default value is OFF.

            dependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.dependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies. The default value is 0.

            alpha=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.alpha "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the coefficient that will multiply the shear
                contribution to the Hashin’s fiber initiation criterion. The default value is 0.0.

            omega=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.omega "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor used for filtering the ratio of principal strain rates
                used for the evaluation of the MSFLD damage initiation criterion. The default value is
                1.0.

            tolerance=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.tolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the tolerance within which the damage initiation criterion must be
                satisfied. The default value is 0.05.

            direction=`abaqusConstants.NMORI`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.direction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation direction. Possible values are NMORI
                and TMORI. The default value is NMORI.

            position=`abaqusConstants.CENTROID`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.QuadeDamageInitiation.position "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation position. Possible values are
                CENTROID, CRACKTIP and COMBINED. The default value is CENTROID.

    :   This method creates A DamageInitiation object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].materials[name].ShearDamageInitiation
        session.odbs[name].materials[name].ShearDamageInitiation
        ```

        Note

        Check [ShearDamageInitiation on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-sheardamageinitiationpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   table[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described in the “Table data”
                section.

            definition=`abaqusConstants.MSFLD`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.definition "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation definition. Possible values are FLD
                and MSFLD. The default value is MSFLD.

            feq=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.feq "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for equivalent
                Plastic strains. The default value is 10.0.

            fnn=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.fnn "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for strains
                normal to the groove direction. The default value is 10.0.

            fnt=`10`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.fnt "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the critical value of the deformation severity index for shear
                strains. The default value is 10.0.

            frequency=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.frequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the frequency, in increments, at which the Marciniak-Kuczynski
                analysis is going to be performed. The default value is 1.

            ks=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.ks "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of Ks. The default value is 0.0.

            numberImperfections=`4`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.numberImperfections "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of imperfections to be considered for the evaluation of the
                Marciniak-Kuczynski analysis. These imperfections are assumed to be equally spaced in
                the angular direction. The default value is 4.

            temperatureDependency=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.temperatureDependency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Boolean specifying whether the data depend on temperature. The default value is OFF.

            dependencies=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.dependencies "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the number of field variable dependencies. The default value is 0.

            alpha=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.alpha "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the value of the coefficient that will multiply the shear
                contribution to the Hashin’s fiber initiation criterion. The default value is 0.0.

            omega=`1`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.omega "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the factor used for filtering the ratio of principal strain rates
                used for the evaluation of the MSFLD damage initiation criterion. The default value is
                1.0.

            tolerance=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.tolerance "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the tolerance within which the damage initiation criterion must be
                satisfied. The default value is 0.05.

            direction=`abaqusConstants.NMORI`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.ShearDamageInitiation.direction "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the damage initiation direction. Possible values are NMORI
                and TMORI. The default value is NMORI.

    :   This method creates a Viscoelastic object.

        Note

        This function can be accessed by:

        ```python
        mdb.models[name].materials[name].Viscoelastic
        session.odbs[name].materials[name].Viscoelastic
        ```

        Note

        Check [Viscoelastic on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-viscoelasticpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

        Parameters:[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Viscoelastic-parameters "Permalink to this headline")
        :   domain[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Viscoelastic.domain "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the domain definition. Possible values are:
                - FREQUENCY, specifying a frequency domain. This domain is only available for an Abaqus/Standard analysis.
                - TIME, specifying a time domain.

            table[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Viscoelastic.table "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described below.

            frequency=`abaqusConstants.FORMULA`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Viscoelastic.frequency "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the frequency domain definition. This argument is required
                only when **domain** = FREQUENCY. Possible values are FORMULA, TABULAR, PRONY,
                CREEP\_TEST\_DATA, and RELAXATION\_TEST\_DATA. The default value is FORMULA.

            type=`abaqusConstants.ISOTROPIC`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Viscoelastic.type "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the type. This argument is required only when
                **domain** = FREQUENCY and **frequency** = TABULAR. Possible values are ISOTROPIC and TRACTION.
                The default value is ISOTROPIC.

            preload=`abaqusConstants.NONE`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Viscoelastic.preload "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the preload. This argument is required only when
                **domain** = FREQUENCY and **frequency** = TABULAR. Possible values are NONE, UNIAXIAL,
                VOLUMETRIC, and UNIAXIAL\_VOLUMETRIC. The default value is NONE.

            time=`abaqusConstants.PRONY`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Viscoelastic.time "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A SymbolicConstant specifying the time domain definition. This argument is required only
                when **domain** = TIME. Possible values are PRONY, CREEP\_TEST\_DATA, RELAXATION\_TEST\_DATA,
                and FREQUENCY\_DATA. The default value is PRONY.

            errtol=`0`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Viscoelastic.errtol "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A Float specifying the allowable average root-mean-square error of the data points in
                the least-squares fit. The Float values correspond to percentages; for example, 0.01 is
                1%. The default value is 0.01.This argument is valid only when **time** = CREEP\_TEST\_DATA,
                RELAXATION\_TEST\_DATA or FREQUENCY\_DATA; or only when **frequency** = CREEP\_TEST\_DATA or
                RELAXATION\_TEST\_DATA.

            nmax=`13`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Viscoelastic.nmax "Permalink to this definition")
            :   An Int specifying the maximum number of terms NN in the Prony series. The maximum value
                is 13. The default value is 13.This argument is valid only when **time** = CREEP\_TEST\_DATA,
                RELAXATION\_TEST\_DATA or FREQUENCY\_DATA; or only when **frequency** = CREEP\_TEST\_DATA or
                RELAXATION\_TEST\_DATA.

            volumetricTable=`()`[¶](#abaqus.Material.Material.Material.Viscoelastic.volumetricTable "Permalink to this definition")
            :   A sequence of sequences of Floats specifying the items described below. The default
                value is an empty sequence.

    The Hyperfoam object specifies elastic properties for a hyperelastic foam.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import material
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].hyperfoam
    import odbMaterial
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].hyperfoam
    ```

    The table data for this object are:
    The items in the table data specify the following for values of nn:

    * \(\mu\_i\) and \(\alpha\_i\) for \(i\) from 1 to \(n\).
    * :math:nu\_i`.
    * Temperature, if the data depend on temperature. Temperature dependence is not allowed for \(4\le n\le 6\) in an
      Abaqus/Explicit analysis.

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * HYPERFOAM

    Note

    Check [Hyperfoam on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-hyperfoampyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The PlanarTestData object specifies planar test (or pure shear) data (compression and/or tension).

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import material
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].hyperelastic.planarTestData
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].hyperfoam.planarTestData
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].mullinsEffect.planarTests[i]
    import odbMaterial
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].hyperelastic.planarTestData
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].hyperfoam.planarTestData
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].mullinsEffect.planarTests[i]
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    * For a hyperelastic material model, the table data specify the following:

      > + Nominal stress, \(T\_{S}\)
      > + Nominal strain in the direction of loading, \(\epsilon\_{S}\).
    * For a hyperfoam material model, the table data specify the following:

      > + Nominal stress, \(T\_{L}\).
      > + Nominal strain in the direction of loading, \(\epsilon\_{p}\).
      > + Nominal transverse strain, \(\epsilon\_{3}\). The default value is 0 .

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * PLANAR TEST DATA

    Note

    Check [PlanarTestData on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-planartestdatapyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    The SimpleShearTestData object provides simple shear test data.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python

    import odbMaterial
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].hyperfoam.simpleShearTestData
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    * Nominal shear stress, \(T\_{S}\).
    * Nominal shear strain, \(\gamma\)
    * Nominal transverse stress, \(T\_{T}\) (normal to edge with shear stress). This stress value is optional.

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * SIMPLE SHEAR TEST DATA

    Check [SimpleShearTestData on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-simplesheartestdatapyc.htm?contextscope=all).

    The UniaxialTestData object provides uniaxial test data (compression and/or tension).

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import material
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].hyperelastic.uniaxialTestData
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].hyperfoam.uniaxialTestData
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].lowDensityFoam.uniaxialCompressionTestData
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].lowDensityFoam.uniaxialTensionTestData
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].mullinsEffect.uniaxialTests[i]
    import odbMaterial
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].hyperelastic.uniaxialTestData
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].hyperfoam.uniaxialTestData
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].lowDensityFoam.uniaxialCompressionTestData
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].lowDensityFoam.uniaxialTensionTestData
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].mullinsEffect.uniaxialTests[i]
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    * For a hyperelastic material model, the table data specify the following:

      > + Nominal stress, \(T\_{U}\).
      > + Nominal strain, \(\epsilon\_{U}\).
    * For a hyperfoam material model, the table data specify the following:

      > + Nominal stress, \(T\_{L}\).
      > + Nominal strain, \(\epsilon\_{U}\).
      > + Nominal lateral strain, \(\epsilon\_{2}=\epsilon\_{3}\). The default value is 0 .
    * For a low-density foam material model, the table data specify the following:

      > + Nominal stress, \(T\_{U}\).
      > + Nominal strain, \(\epsilon\_{U}\).
      > + Nominal strain rate, \(\dot{\epsilon\_{U}}\).

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * UNIAXIAL TEST DATA

    Note

    Check [UniaxialTestData on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-uniaxialtestdatapyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The VolumetricTestData object provides volumetric test data.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import material
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].hyperelastic.volumetricTestData
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].hyperfoam.volumetricTestData
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].viscoelastic.volumetricTestData
    import odbMaterial
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].hyperelastic.volumetricTestData
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].hyperfoam.volumetricTestData
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].viscoelastic.volumetricTestData
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    * For a hyperelastic or hyperfoam material model, the table data specify the following:

      > + Pressure, \(p\).
      > + Volume ratio, \(J\) (current volume/original volume).
    * For a viscoelastic material model, the values depend on the value of the **time** member of the
      Viscoelastic object.

      > + If **time** = RELAXATION\_TEST\_DATA, the table data specify the following:
      >
      >   > - Normalized volumetric (bulk) modulus \(k\_{R}(t), \quad\left(0 \leq k\_{R}(t) \leq 1\right)\)
      >   > - Time \(t (t>0)\).
      > + If **time** = CREEP\_TEST\_DATA, the table data specify the following:
      >
      >   > - Normalized volumetric (bulk) compliance \(j\_{K}(t), \quad\left(j\_{K}(t) \geq 1\right)\).
      >   > - Time \(t(t>0)\)

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * VOLUMETRIC TEST DATA

    Note

    Check [VolumetricTestData on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-volumetrictestdatapyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The Hyperelastic object specifies elastic properties for approximately incompressible elastomers.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import material
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].hyperelastic
    import odbMaterial
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].hyperelastic
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    * If **type** = ARRUDA\_BOYCE, the table data specify the following:

      > + \(\mu\).
      > + \(\lambda\_{m}\).
      > + \(D\).
      > + Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * If **type** = MOONEY\_RIVLIN, the table data specify the following:

      > + \(C\_{10}\)
      > + \(C\_{01}\).
      > + \(D\_{1}\).
      > + Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * If **type** = NEO\_HOOKE, the table data specify the following:

      > + \(C\_{10}\)
      > + \(D\_{1}\).
      > + Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * If **type** = OGDEN, the table data specify the following for values of nn:

      > + \(\mu\_{i}\) and \(\alpha\_{i}\) for \(i\) from 1 to \(n\).
      > + \(n\) coefficients \(D\_{i}\).
      > + Temperature, if the data depend on temperature. Temperature dependence is not
      >   allowed for \(4 \leq n \leq 6\) in an Abaqus/Explicit analysis.
    * If **type** = POLYNOMIAL, the table data specify the following for values of nn:

      > + \(C\_{i j}\) for each value of \((i+j)\) from 1 to \(n\) with
      >   \(i\) decreasing from \((i+j)\) to zero and \(j\) increasing
      >   from zero to \((i+j)\).
      > + \(n\) coefficients \(D\_{i}\)
      > + Temperature, if the data depend on temperature. Temperature dependence is
      >   not allowed for \(3 \leq n \leq 6\) in an Abaqus/Explicit analysis.
    * If **type** = REDUCED\_POLYNOMIAL, the table data specify the following for values of nn:

      > + \(C\_{i 0}\) for \(i\) from 1 to \(n\).
      > + \(n\) coefficients \(D\_{i}\)
      > + Temperature, if the data depend on temperature. Temperature dependence
      >   is not allowed for \(4 \leq n \leq 6\) in an Abaqus/Explicit analysis.
    * If **type** = VAN\_DER\_WAALS, the table data specify the following:

      > + \(\mu\).
      > + \(\lambda\_{m}\).
      > + \(a\).
      > + \(\beta\).
      > + \(D\).
      > + Temperature, if the data depend on temperature.
    * If **type** = YEOH, the table data specify the following:

      > + \(C\_{10}\)
      > + \(C\_{20}\)
      > + \(C\_{30}\)
      > + \(D\_{1}\).
      > + \(D\_{2}\)
      > + \(D\_{3}\).
      > + Temperature, if the data depend on temperature. Temperature dependence
      >   is not allowed in an Abaqus/Explicit analysis.

    The None object is the default value if **testData** = ON.

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * HYPERELASTIC

    Note

    Check [Hyperelastic on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-hyperelasticpyc.htm?contextscope=all).

*class* Hysteresis(*[table](#abaqus.Material.Elastic.HyperElastic.ViscoElastic.Hysteresis.Hysteresis "abaqus.Material.Elastic.HyperElastic.ViscoElastic.Hysteresis.Hysteresis.__init__.table (Python parameter)")*)[[source]](https://github.com/haiiliin/abqpy/blob/2025/src/abaqus/Material/Elastic/HyperElastic/ViscoElastic/Hysteresis.py#L6-L65)[¶](#abaqus.Material.Elastic.HyperElastic.ViscoElastic.Hysteresis.Hysteresis "Permalink to this definition")
:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The Hysteresis object specifies the creep part of the material model for the hysteretic behavior of
    elastomers.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import material
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].hyperelastic.hysteresis
    import odbMaterial
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].hyperelastic.hysteresis
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    * Stress scaling factor.
    * Creep parameter.
    * Effective stress exponent.
    * Creep strain exponent.

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * HYSTERESIS

    Note

:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The CombinedTestData object specifies simultaneously the normalized shear and bulk compliances or
    relaxation moduli as functions of time.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import material
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].viscoelastic.combinedTestData
    import odbMaterial
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].viscoelastic.combinedTestData
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    If **time** = RELAXATION\_TEST\_DATA, the table data specify the following:

    * Normalized shear modulus, \(g\_R(t)\) (\(0\le g\_R(t)\le 1\)).
    * Normalized volumetric (bulk) modulus, \(k\_R(t)\) (\(0\le k\_R(t)\le 1\)).
    * Time \(t\) (\(t>0\)).

    If **time** = CREEP\_TEST\_DATA, the table data specify the following:

    * Normalized shear compliance, \(j\_S(t)\) (\(j\_S(t)\ge 1\)).
    * Normalized volumetric (bulk) compliance, \(j\_K(t)\) (\(j\_K(t)\ge 1\)).
    * Time \(t\) (\(t>0\)).

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * COMBINED TEST DATA

    Note

    Check [CombinedTestData on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-combinedtestdatapyc.htm?contextscope=all).

:   Bases: [`object`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#object "(in Python v3.13)")

    The ShearTestData object specifies the normalized shear creep compliance or relaxation modulus as a
    function of time.

    Note

    This object can be accessed by:

    ```python
    import material
    mdb.models[name].materials[name].viscoelastic.shearTestData
    import odbMaterial
    session.odbs[name].materials[name].viscoelastic.shearTestData
    ```

    The table data for this object are:

    * If **time** = RELAXATION\_TEST\_DATA, the table data specify the following:

      > + Normalized shear relaxation modulus \(g\_{R}(t)\). \(\left(0 \leq g\_{R}(t) \leq 1\right)\)
      > + Time \(t (t>0)\).
    * If **time** = CREEP\_TEST\_DATA, the table data specify the following:

      > + Normalized shear compliance \(j\_{S}(t)\). \(\left(j\_{S}(t) \geq 1\right)\).
      > + Time \(t (t>0)\).

    The corresponding analysis keywords are:

    * SHEAR TEST DATA

    Note

    Check [ShearTestData on help.3ds.com/2025](https://help.3ds.com/2025/English/DSSIMULIA_Established/SIMACAEKERRefMap/simaker-c-sheartestdatapyc.htm?contextscope=all).
